FIELDS.NAME: Bite & Delight Family Eatery
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Restaurant Manager, 1234 Fast Lane, Suite 100, Springfield, IL 62701-1234, Phone: (555) 123-4567, Email: johnsmith@biteanddelight.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Bite & Delight Family Eatery is a family-friendly dining establishment specializing in quick service meals, offering a diverse menu that includes burgers, sandwiches, salads, and children's options. Our operations focus on providing a comfortable, clean environment with a seating capacity of up to 150, ensuring that families can enjoy dining together. We are proud to maintain rigorous health and safety standards, with regular staff training in food safety protocols and kitchen maintenance. Our restaurant features a welcoming atmosphere and efficient service model, without offering table service, to minimize operational complexity. Additionally, we do not serve alcoholic beverages, thus significantly reducing our liability exposure. Our commitment to high-quality food and exceptional customer service is at the heart of our operations.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not exceed 7,500 square feet in total floor area and maintains a seating capacity of no greater than 150. We confirm that table service is not offered, and sales of beer and wine are limited to 25% of total sales, with no other liquor sales permitted.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Bite & Delight Bakery and Café, 4567 Sweet Street, Springfield, IL 62701-5678, Family Bakery specializing in artisanal pastries and desserts.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 05/10/2022, water damage occurred due to a burst pipe in the kitchen, resulting in a claim of $3,000, currently resolved. On 08/15/2023, a minor slip-and-fall incident led to a claim of $2,000, still under review.
